build.description: Compile all packages and apps (Next.js, tsc, bundlers). Depends on upstream ^build.

dev.description: Start dev servers in watch mode for all packages/apps. Persistent, no cache.

lint.description: Run ESLint across all packages/apps. No dependencies on builds.

typecheck.description: Run TypeScript type-checking (tsc --noEmit) across all packages/apps.

test.description: Run test suites (vitest/jest). Depends on build to ensure compiled output exists.

clean.description: Remove build artifacts (dist, .next, node_modules/.cache). No caching.
